title: Merdeka Gold shares jump by limit after Indonesia’s biggest IPO
body: Merdeka raised 4.66 trillion rupiah ($281 million) by selling a 10% stake in the IPO.

title: Gold miner seeks $284 million in largest Indonesia IPO this year
body: PT Merdeka Gold Resources will offer 1.62 billion shares, or a 10% stake.

title: Indonesia’s United Tractors seeks expansion with gold miner acquisition

title: Nickel shortage, higher costs pinch Indonesian producers

title: Antam Posts 240% Net Profit Surge in 1H25, Fueled by Nickel Boom and Strong Gold Sales
body: PT Aneka Tambang (Antam) recorded a 240% jump in net profit to Rp5.14 trillion in the first half of 2025, driven by a nickel profit of Rp3.53 trillion and a 125% rise in nickel sales to Rp7.87 trillion, while gold sales surged 163% to Rp49.54 trillion, representing 84% of total revenue. The company also achieved record quarterly nickel ore sales of 8.20 million wet metric tons, launched a Smelter Grade Alumina Refinery in Mempawah with Inalum, and advanced its 2030 decarbonization roadmap, targeting a 15.8% cut in scope 1 and 2 emissions and a 10% increase in renewable energy mix, with ESG metrics such as SROI > 2 and TRIFR below the global average.

title: PT Timah Tbk Reports 32% Production Drop, Seeks DPR Support to Revive Tin Mining
body: During a 22 September 2025 RDP with DPR VI, PT Timah Tbk disclosed a 32% YoY decline in tin ore production and a 19% drop in revenue, yet its average selling price rose 8% to USD 32,816 per metric ton. The company outlined plans to open new mines, expand KIP partnerships, launch CSR‑driven cooperatives, and requested regulatory backing to reintegrate illegal mining output, accelerate downstream processing, and address zoning changes that hinder offshore operations.
